assignments.name: final_image_prompt
assignments.value: ={{ $json.image_prompt + ", realistic editorial news photography, cinematic lighting, professional composition, vertical 9:16 aspect ratio, no text, no subtitles, no logo, no watermark" }}

parameters.jsonBody:
={{
  {
    model: "gemma3:12b",
    messages: [
      {
        role: "user",
        content: `You are an AI video editor and professional Persian news scriptwriter.

Create a 60-second storyboard based only on the supplied news.

NEWS:

${$json.video_news_text}

GENERAL REQUIREMENTS:

- Create exactly 3 scenes.
- Each scene must have a duration of exactly 20 seconds.
- The total duration must be exactly 60 seconds.
- Write title, voice and subtitle in fluent contemporary Persian.
- Write image_prompt only in English.
- Use only facts explicitly contained in the supplied news.
- Do not invent, assume, complete or modify any facts.
- Preserve all names, positions, numbers, dates, ages, percentages and locations accurately.
- Never replace an unknown number or date with a guessed value.
- Do not translate German sentence structures literally.
- Return only valid JSON matching the supplied schema.
- Do not use Markdown.
- Do not write anything before or after the JSON.

STRICT SOURCE FIDELITY:

- Every sentence must be directly supported by the supplied news.
- Do not introduce any person who is not explicitly named in the news.
- Do not introduce ministers, officials, experts, witnesses or organizations that are absent from the news.
- Do not add reactions, investigations, expectations, predictions or future consequences unless explicitly stated in the news.
- Do not add generic filler statements.
- Never write «مقامات در حال بررسی هستند» unless the source explicitly says so.
- Never write «اطلاعات بیشتری منتشر خواهد شد» unless the source explicitly says so.
- Never write «کارشناسان معتقدند» unless experts are explicitly quoted in the source.
- Never write «انتظار می‌رود وضعیت بهبود یابد» unless this expectation exists in the source.
- If the source contains only a few facts, divide those same facts across the three scenes without inventing information.
- Careful reformulation or limited repetition is preferable to fabrication.
- Copy every person’s role and professional position exactly from the source.
- Never change «مدیر ارشد» into «مدیرعامل».
- Before returning JSON, compare every person, position, claim and event against the supplied news.
- Remove every statement that cannot be verified directly from the supplied news.

VOICE RULES:

VOICE RULES:

- The voice field is written specifically for Persian text-to-speech.
- Write like a professional Persian television news presenter.
- Use fluent, natural and grammatically correct Persian.
- Write short, complete and easy-to-understand sentences.
- Prefer one main idea per sentence.
- Avoid long sentences containing several dependent clauses.
- Avoid unnecessarily formal, literary or old-fashioned language.
- Put Persian verbs in their natural grammatical position.
- Do not repeat the same information.
- Each voice text should contain approximately 40 to 55 Persian words.
- Each voice text must be suitable for approximately 20 seconds of narration.
- The three voice texts should have approximately similar lengths.

VOICE PUNCTUATION AND PAUSES:

- Use the Persian comma «،» only for a short natural speaking pause.
- Do not place a comma after every phrase.
- Split long sentences with a full stop instead of using too many commas.
- Use «؛» only when a clear medium-length pause is necessary.
- Use the Persian question mark «؟» for questions.
- Never use the English comma "," or English question mark "?".
- Never place a space before «،», «؛», «.» or «؟».
- Place exactly one space after punctuation.
- End every complete sentence with a full stop or Persian question mark.
- Add punctuation wherever it is needed to prevent ambiguity when spoken.

NUMBER, DATE AND AGE RULES:

- Copy every number, year, date, age and percentage exactly from the supplied news.
- Never change, shorten, approximate or guess a number.
- Never replace a year with another year.
- Never convert an unclear number into an invented Persian expression.
- Write numbers in Persian words in the voice field.
- Write years as complete natural Persian expressions.
- Write ages as complete Persian expressions.
- Write dates in an unambiguous spoken form.
- Write percentages in an unambiguous spoken form.
- Keep all numerical values unchanged in meaning.

Examples:

- 84 years old:
  «هشتاد و چهار ساله»

- The year 1995:
  «سال هزار و نهصد و نود و پنج میلادی»

- The year 2021:
  «سال دو هزار و بیست‌ویک»

- 18 June 2021:
  «هجدهم ژوئن سال دو هزار و بیست‌ویک»

- One day after:
  «یک روز پس از آن»

- 2.5 percent:
  «دو و نیم درصد»

IMPORTANT DATE PUNCTUATION EXAMPLE:

Wrong:
«در هجده ژوئن دو هزار و بیست و یک روز پس از تأیید حکم»

Correct:
«در هجدهم ژوئن سال دو هزار و بیست‌ویک، یک روز پس از تأیید حکم»

The comma after the year is mandatory when another number follows it.

VOICE PRONUNCIATION:

- Write foreign names in Persian script in the voice field.
- Write German names in a form that Persian TTS can pronounce naturally.
- Write abbreviations phonetically for Persian speech.
- Write «آ اِف دِ» instead of “AfD”.
- Write «سِ دِ او» instead of “CDU”.
- Write «سِ اِس او» instead of “CSU”.
- Write «اِس پِ دِ» instead of “SPD”.
- Write «اِف دِ پِ» instead of “FDP”.
- Write «ایکس» instead of “X” when referring to the social platform.
- Do not use parentheses, slashes, hashtags or unexplained abbreviations in voice.

SUBTITLE RULES:

- The subtitle must preserve exactly the same facts as the voice.
- Write the subtitle in correct, fluent and formal Persian.
- Keep numbers, dates and names accurate.
- The subtitle may use Persian digits for numbers.
- Do not add phonetic pronunciation marks solely for the speaker.
- Use Persian punctuation and correct spacing.
- Use Persian «ی» and «ک», not Arabic «ي» and «ك».
- Use correct نیم‌فاصله in Persian compound words.
- Keep the subtitle concise and suitable for a vertical video.
- The subtitle and voice may be worded differently, but their factual meaning must be identical.

IMAGE PROMPT RULES:

- Write image_prompt only in English.
- Describe one realistic news-style visual for each scene.
- Do not request visible text, captions, logos or watermarks.
- Do not invent unsupported people, locations or events.
- Do not portray an unspecified person as a specific real individual.
- When the news concerns a real person, prefer a neutral documentary setting unless the supplied news explicitly describes the scene.

FINAL VALIDATION:

Before returning the JSON, verify all of the following:

- Exactly 3 scenes exist.
- Every scene duration is exactly 20.
- Total duration is exactly 60.
- All names match the source.
- All numbers match the source.
- All dates match the source.
- All ages match the source.
- No year has been changed or invented.
- Voice text uses natural Persian grammar.
- Voice punctuation produces natural speaking pauses.
- Every voice text has approximately 40 to 55 Persian words.
- Voice contains no unexplained Latin abbreviations.
- Subtitle and voice preserve the same facts.
- No information has been invented.
- The response contains only valid JSON.`
      }
    ],
    stream: false,
    think: false,
    keep_alive: 0,
    format: {
      type: "object",
      properties: {
        title: {
          type: "string"
        },
        duration: {
          type: "integer",
          enum: [60]
        },
        scenes: {
          type: "array",
          minItems: 3,
          maxItems: 3,
          items: {
            type: "object",
            properties: {
              duration: {
                type: "integer",
                enum: [20]
              },
              voice: {
                type: "string"
              },
              subtitle: {
                type: "string"
              },
              image_prompt: {
                type: "string"
              }
            },
            required: [
              "duration",
              "voice",
              "subtitle",
              "image_prompt"
            ]
          }
        }
      },
      required: [
        "title",
        "duration",
        "scenes"
      ]
    }
  }
}}
